summary: Recent updates to the WebRTC web API, specifically to the RTCPeerConnection, focus on improving the efficiency and functionality of video and audio communication. Notable changes include the simplification of the **iceConnectionState** getter, which makes it easier for developers to access connection states without additional overhead. Additionally, the implementation of **RTCError** for DTLS (Datagram Transport Layer Security) enhances error handling during secure communications. The updates also refine how codec configurations and RTP (Real-Time Protocol) header extensions are managed, which impacts how audio and video streams are processed. Overall, these enhancements facilitate smoother and more reliable real-time communications essential for applications like video conferencing and online gaming.
